currentRoundInspection.method: Three pictures visually inspected in the browser. Standard viewer PMTiles supplies geographic fit; no bespoke surveys or research documents.
observations: Low thin slate-stone walls with broken crests, open rooms and tall isolated remnants; no complete roofed castle.
Island and mainland courtyards separated by a gorge; pale narrow footbridge has red lower chords, silver lattice and tapered cantilevers.
Aerial shows the hall/court at the bridge island end, upper mainland rooms uphill, garden/chapel and scattered low island foundations.
currentRoundInspection.usage: External visual references only. Photographs are not copied, redistributed, embedded or used as textures.
